== What changed on the image ==
[[File:CC-L-landocalrissian-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lando Calrissian (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 24 January 2018): Same words. The text box is set again (the same words, with the lines broken as on the 2017 slip), the bronze disc is gone and a white italic “E” is in the black lower border.

The same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width and the same area of the 2018 image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
